correctness.rationale: PASS: Hopf-Jacobi separation gives exactly 25 degree-four basis modes labelled (m,n), 9 absolute weight sectors (a,b) with a+b∈{0,2,4}, j=(4-a-b)/2; normalization squared 5 j!(j+a+b)!/((j+a)!(j+b)!) verified by Jacobi beta integrals, diagonal restriction to unique torus Fourier mode per basis vector. Independently integrated each of nine rational sector polynomials to 1 and counted multiplicities summing to 25. Two bottlenecks U(t)=5t^4, V(t)=30t(1-t)(2t-1)² imply A(t)≤min(U,V). On 0<t≤1/2 U strictly increases; after unique crossing tau∈(.42,.43), V strictly decreases, forcing global upper max at tau. Remaining seven sector values have exact rational interval lower bounds >5tau^4, so bound attained and six modes (±4,0),(±1,±1) only. Coordinate swap gives the second optimal torus; unique cubic crossing and strict inequalities exclude others. Independent computation gives tau≈.425313431933887, minimum≈.163608701688480; no finite sample used as global proof.
